description: Run a saved chatbot test now: nopaque holds the conversation with the chatbot and judges it against the acceptance. Takes the chatbot test `id` (from createDigitalTestConfig or listDigitalTestConfigs). Returns the run at once; read the outcome with getDigitalTestRun, which is usually ready after a minute or two. This uses the workspace's minutes or credit and cannot be undone; when a person is present, get a yes first. Use when: a chatbot test should be run.

connectorId.description: Run against a different saved connector than the config's default.

name: runDigitalTest
title: Run a Chatbot Test
